evals.name: Multiple d6 rolls for fireball damage
evals.prompt: My wizard just cast Fireball at 3rd level, which is 8d6 fire damage. Roll all eight d6 for me and give me the total.
evals.expected_output: The response rolls a six-sided die eight times using a random number command (e.g., echo $((RANDOM % 6 + 1)) repeated or in a loop), lists the individual results, and gives the correct sum.

assertions.text: The command uses 6 as the number of sides (e.g., RANDOM % 6 + 1 or -Maximum 7)
The response reports exactly eight individual die results
Every individual reported die result is an integer between 1 and 6 inclusive
The reported total equals the arithmetic sum of the eight individual results
The reported total is between 8 and 48 inclusive

evals.name: Non-standard d12 roll on Windows PowerShell
evals.prompt: I'm on Windows using PowerShell. Roll a d12 for my barbarian's greataxe damage.
evals.expected_output: The response uses the PowerShell Get-Random command with -Minimum 1 and -Maximum 13 to roll a d12 and reports a result between 1 and 12.

assertions.text: Response includes the PowerShell Get-Random cmdlet
The Get-Random command sets -Maximum to 13 (or equivalently 12 + 1), accounting for the exclusive upper bound
The reported roll result is a single integer between 1 and 12 inclusive
